Faq.title: What people ask most
Faq.description: No SSN, down payment, clean title, and driving away. In plain words.

f01.q: Do I need an SSN (Social Security)?
f01.a: No. We use in-house financing — you don’t depend on a bank. Bring passport and license. Approval is subject to review.

f02.a: Passport and license. If you have more papers, bring them; they’re not required to start. We’ll tell you on WhatsApp if anything else is needed for your case.

f03.a: Bring it with your passport and we’ll review it. Sebastián confirms the final answer, car by car.

f04.a: The price you see is the amount to finance after the down payment. The down payment can start from $2,000*. We confirm it on WhatsApp, car by car. Subject to approval. Not cash price.

f05.a: We list cars with a clean title: no salvage and no surprises. If a car doesn’t have it, we don’t sell it as if it did.

f06.q: Can I drive away the same day?
f06.a: It’s possible, subject to approval and bringing passport, license, and down payment. It’s not automatic — we confirm once we see your case.

f07.q: What if I miss a payment?
f07.a: Talk to us first. We prefer to work with you than surprise you. Rules are explained at signing, in writing.

f08.q: Can I get insurance in my name?
f08.a: The car goes in your name. Insurance can too; if you don’t have it yet, we’ll tell you what you need before pickup. Confirm with Sebastián when you choose the car.

f09.q: Is this the same as Apolo?
f09.a: No. Apolo is in Miami-Dade. Titanium South Florida / Kiko Cars is in Broward: Hollywood and nearby. Same family, different location.
